verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents a REST API, authenticated with secret keys, for sensitive actions such as refunds and granting promotional entitlements. Its MCP server and AI Toolkit can also manage apps, Products, Entitlements, Offerings and Packages without the dashboard, so much of the configuration surface is programmable. However, nothing shows full API parity with the UI: charts, paywall editing and publishing, and data-export scheduling are described only as dashboard features, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement or complete API reference, API coverage for charts/metrics, paywall editing and scheduled exports, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The RevenueCat MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enables AI assistants to manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard.
there are various endpoints that can be used for refunding purchases, granting promotional entitlements, and other sensitive actions that can only be done via a Secret API key from your server.
Set up subscriptions, including projects, apps, Products, Entitlements, Offerings, and Packages
RevenueCat authenticates requests from the RevenueCat SDK and the REST API using API keys.
